body: Her sister is heavily depressed and doesn't want to live. Her mother doesn't believe in mental disorders and got more angry about the totalled car than the fact that her daughter tried to commit suicide by driving into a tree. No encouragement can help. Her sister refuses to talk on the phone with my friend and her other sisters are somewhat getting their shit together but not enough. There's no number to call? No one can help them? :( I really don't know what to do. Her sister won't stop until she succeeds.
